subject: Enron Cover Letter & Resume for Dave Gershenson
body_plain:
Vince, I am passing along a cover letter and resume for my classmate and 
friend, Dave Gershenson, who is very interested in working for Enron this 
summer. He is working on Reliant Energy's Tiger Team this quarter. Please let 
us know if you have any questions.

Thanks much and see you Friday!
Vincent
--------------------------------------------
Vincent Y Chen
MBA Candidate, Class of 2002
The Wharton School
University of Pennsylvania
chenvinc@wharton.upenn.edu


>  -----Original Message-----
> From:  Gershenson, David
> Sent: Tuesday, January 16, 2001 6:24 AM
> To: Chen, Vincent
> Subject: Enron Cover Letter & Resume
>
> Vincent,
>
> Please find attached a cover letter and resume for the Enron summer finance 
internship.  As we discussed, I would appreciate it if you could pass these 
along to your Tiger Team contact, Mr. Kaminski.
>
> Thanks,
> Dave
